summary.answer: Builds a party-count footer. Defines and immediately invokes both private-count and matchmaking-count text functions, then subscribes those same functions to private/game client updates. Matchmaking state tests publicLobby.stage against INVALID and is separately revalidated on stage changes. No party membership changes are implied. Creates self via LUI.UIHorizontalList.new, Label via LUI.UIText.new, Spacer2 via LUI.UIImage.new, Spacer via LUI.UIImage.new, PartyCount via LUI.UIText.new, MatchmakingCount via LUI.UIText.new.
